bio.text: Ron Napoli represents Waterbury's 73rd District in the Connecticut House and is Assistant Majority Leader.
He previously served on Waterbury's Board of Aldermen, including six years as President Pro-Tempore.
A public school teacher, he graduated from Salve Regina University in 1999 with a degree in European History and from the University of Bridgeport in 2003 with a degree in Secondary Education.
He is a lifelong Waterbury resident.
